methods: money, add, multiply, toDecimal.code: import { money } from '@ducatjs/money'; const a = money('1.00', 'EUR'); console.log(a.add(a).multiply('1.075', 'halfEven').toDecimal());

functions: money, add, multiply, toDecim.code: import { money, add, multiply, toDecimal } from '@ducatjs/money/fn'; import '@ducatjs/money/iso/EUR'; const a = money('1.00', 'EUR'); console.log(toDecimal(multiply(add(a, a), '1.075', 'halfEven')));

functions, dinero.js shape: fromMinor, a.code: import { fromMinor, add, multiply, toDecimal } from '@ducatjs/money/fn'; import '@ducatjs/money/iso/EUR'; const a = fromMinor(100, 'EUR'); console.log(toDecimal(multiply(add(a, a), '1.075', 'halfEven')));

functions: fromMinor, add, toDecimal.code: import { fromMinor, add, toDecimal } from '@ducatjs/money/fn'; import '@ducatjs/money/iso/EUR'; const a = fromMinor(100, 'EUR'); console.log(toDecimal(add(a, a)));

functions: a currency context with /iso/.code: import { currencyContext } from '@ducatjs/money/fn'; import '@ducatjs/money/iso/EUR'; const eur = currencyContext('EUR', { locale: 'nl-NL' }); console.log(eur.format(eur.money('1234.5')));

functions: a currency context with parse.code: import { currencyContext, parse } from '@ducatjs/money/fn'; import '@ducatjs/money/iso/EUR'; const eur = currencyContext('EUR', { locale: 'nl-NL', parse }); console.log(eur.format(eur.parse('1.234,50')));
